Do not use a propane torch to heat the detectors because the light flam 
 temperature of the torch may destroy calibration of the detectors.

It is not possible to accurately check the calibration of the detectors by 
 heating it in an oil bath or with a heat lamp because the set point of the 
 detectors is sensitive to the rate of heading which cannot be easily 
 determined without specialized equipment.
Connect all detectors in the same place.
Connect the power supply to the system.
Put the system at automatic mode.

NOTE
Do not use a propane torch to heat the detectors because the light flam 
 temperature of the torch may destroy calibration of the detectors.
It is not possible to accurately check the calibration of the detectors by 
 heating it in an oil bath or with a heat lamp because the set point of the 
 detectors is sensitive to the rate of heading which cannot be easily 
 determined without specialized equipment.
